definitions.gloss: Japan and the United States, Japan-US, Japanese-American (bilateral)
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation combining 日 (Japan) and 米 (America/US), used as a prefix or noun to refer to the bilateral relationship, agreements, or interactions between Japan and the United States.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
{日米|にちべい}⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A Japan-US summit meeting was held.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}{安全保障条約|あんぜんほしょうじょうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The Japan-US Security Treaty forms the foundation of the alliance between both countries.

notes:
USAGE:
{日米|にちべい} is a compound abbreviation using the first characters of ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (Japan) and ⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧ (the United States). It functions as a prefix modifying nouns related to bilateral topics.

Similar country-pair abbreviations are common in Japanese:
- ⟦{日中|にっちゅう}→日中：03519_nicchuu⟧: Japan-China
- {日韓|にっかん}: Japan-South Korea
- ⟦{日英|にちえい}→日英：24610_nichiei⟧: Japan-UK
- {日露|にちろ}: Japan-Russia

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日米|にちべい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: Japan-US relations
- {日米|にちべい}⟦{同盟|どうめい}→同盟：05321_doumei⟧: Japan-US alliance
- {日米|にちべい}⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧: Japan-US summit
- {日米|にちべい}⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧: Japan-US trade
- {日米|にちべい}⟦{安保|あんぽ}→安保：12461_anpo⟧: Japan-US security (treaty)
